title: How was it? war and hatte (Wie war dein Wochenende?)
summary: With sein and haben, Germans use a short past: war and hatte. Then put Unit 5 together and tell a colleague about your weekend.
goals: Tell someone about your weekend in 5-6 sentences

nicosWeg.title: Nicos Weg A1, chapter 13: Weather and holiday (Wie war dein Urlaub?)
Nicos Weg A1, chapter 8: Appointments (Zu spät!?)

sections.title: war and hatte
sections.text:
For [[sein]] and [[haben]], Germans don't usually use the Perfekt. They use a short past form instead:
- [[Ich war zu Hause.]] = I was at home.
- [[Ich hatte keine Zeit.]] = I didn't have time.
- [[Wie war dein Wochenende?]] = How was your weekend?

So: [[Ich war am See]] ([[am See]] = at the lake, a chunk: Unit 6), not 'Ich bin am See gewesen' (correct, but less common in speech).

In Bavaria you'll often hear [[Ich habe keine Zeit gehabt.]] It's correct, but use [[hatte]] yourself.
As with the modal verbs: [[ich war]] = [[er war]], [[ich hatte]] = [[er hatte]]. No -t.
Russian был, была, было change with gender. German [[war]] doesn't: [[er war]], [[sie war]], [[es war]].

sections.title: How was the weekend?
sections.text:
On Monday colleagues ask [[Wie war dein Wochenende?]] or [[Was hast du am Wochenende gemacht?]] Answer with a short verdict and one or two details:
- [[Super! Ich war am See.]]
- [[Gut. Ich hatte Zeit und habe lange geschlafen.]]
- [[Nicht so toll. Das Wetter war schlecht.]]
- [[Langweilig. Ich habe nur gearbeitet.]]

Then ask back: [[Und du?]] or [[Und dein Wochenende?]]

sections.title: Your weekend in six sentences
sections.text:
A good order: when, what, how it was. Mix the Perfekt with [[war]] and [[hatte]]:
1. [[Am Samstag bin ich spät aufgestanden.]]
2. [[Dann habe ich eingekauft.]]
3. [[Am Nachmittag war ich am See.]]
4. [[Am Abend haben wir gegrillt.]]
5. [[Am Sonntag habe ich Deutsch gelernt.]]
6. [[Das Wochenende war super!]]

items.de: Guten Morgen! Wie war dein Wochenende?
items.en: Good morning! How was your weekend?

items.de: Super! Am Samstag war ich am See.
items.en: Great! On Saturday I was at the lake.

items.de: Ja! Und du? Was hast du gemacht?
items.en: Yes! And you? What did you do?

items.de: Wir haben zusammen gekocht und viel erzählt.
items.en: We cooked together and talked a lot.

items.question: A colleague asks 'Wie war dein Wochenende?'. Which answer fits?
items.explanation: A short verdict, then a detail.

items.audio: Am Samstag hatte ich keine Zeit, aber am Sonntag war ich am See.
items.question: When was the person at the lake?
items.explanation: am Samstag hatte ich keine Zeit; am Sonntag war ich am See.
